{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Tunisia Youth Impact uses cooking contests to encourage rural women to vote in the presidential election."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "On October 12, a Voticook cooking contest is held in the rural town of Echamine."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "The national turnout in the first round of the election was 48.98%."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Wafa Tarhouni explains that the contest is a practice vote where women compete through their dishes."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Volunteers mimic real voting conditions, replacing ink with a water and shampoo mixture."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "The contest is held at the home of Hinda Jlass, who is participating."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Hinda Jlass says the event is about getting together and plans to vote in the election for the second time."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Seven competitors present their dishes to about fifty electors."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Electors taste the dishes and vote using the same procedure as the real election."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "ISIE members and EU observer Stefan Ziegler are present; Ziegler says it is good for Tunisian democracy."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "After voting, ballots are counted and volunteers point out potential mistakes."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Najwa Jlass wins the contest and says she will vote in the real election."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Crime adapts to societal changes, evolving from individual violations to organized crime."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The Sicilian Cosa Nostra adapted to a changing economy from village-agrarian to urban-industrial."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Organized crime has become networks and alliances across national boundaries."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Drug trafficking leads to corruption, threats, and killings of law enforcement and judges."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Drug proceeds are laundered and reinvested into the legal economy."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Organized crime seeks a power monopoly using any means for profit without concern for others."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Common criminality and organized crime intersect, with many organized criminals starting as thieves."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Organized crime develops a mythology of invincibility used to intimidate."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Informants' confessions have helped document organized crime."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Nigerian criminal enterprises emerged from economic downturn and are highly successful due to bribery of officials."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Nigerian criminal groups are flexible with three types of structures: pyramidal hierarchy, flexible networks, and independent cells."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Nigerian groups target the US and Britain, engaging in heroin trafficking and scams, including a 1999 advance fee fraud and a 1997 check theft, with proceeds funding narcotics smuggling."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Sheriff Turnbull said the tragedy happened because Captain David Traill ignored five fuel warnings."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "He called the decision 'conscious' with 'fatal consequences' for 10 people."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "The police helicopter crashed into the Clutha bar at 22:22 on 29 November 2013."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "The crash killed 10 people and injured 31 others."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Mark O'Prey's father expressed anger, saying Captain Traill was made a 'fall guy'."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Clutha owner Alan Crossan expressed 'shock and disappointment' at the report."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Sheriff Turnbull heard testimony from families, experts, and eyewitnesses during the inquiry."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "The crash occurred because the helicopter's engines 'flamed out' due to fuel exhaustion."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "The fuel tanks were depleted because Captain Traill failed to ensure at least one fuel transfer pump switch was on."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Sheriff Turnbull said the central question was why the pilot ignored the low fuel warnings."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "The accident would not have happened if the pilot had followed the normal procedure for low fuel warnings."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "The pilot's checklist required landing within 10 minutes of a fuel warning."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "Sheriff Turnbull described the failure as 'inexplicable'."},
    {"id": "13", "subevent": "He said Captain Traill 'took a chance' that the warnings were erroneous."},
    {"id": "14", "subevent": "Sheriff Turnbull said the helicopter should have had a warning when both fuel transfer pumps were off."},
    {"id": "15", "subevent": "Both pumps were switched off during the flight."},
    {"id": "16", "subevent": "Sheriff Turnbull said the circumstances were so unusual they are unlikely to be repeated."},
    {"id": "17", "subevent": "He praised the dignity of those who attended the inquiry."},
    {"id": "18", "subevent": "Sheriff Turnbull criticized the delay in confirming no criminal proceedings and in lodging the inquiry."},
    {"id": "19", "subevent": "He said the Crown Office's Helicopter Incidents Investigation Team was under-resourced."},
    {"id": "20", "subevent": "He noted that a FAI into the Sumburgh crash was still pending."},
    {"id": "21", "subevent": "A Crown Office spokesperson acknowledged the time taken was longer than desirable and promised improvements."},
    {"id": "22", "subevent": "Airbus Helicopters expressed sadness and said they noted the findings."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Marines used the Marine Air Defense Integrated System (MADIS) on USS Boxer to down a hostile Iranian drone."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The drone was downed 1,000 yards from the ship during a transit through the Strait of Hormuz."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "MADIS is a combination of electronic jammers, radars, and gun systems mounted on an MRZR on the bow, powered by a gasoline generator."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Naval analyst Thomas Callender said the encounter is the first known kill by a new generation of electronic warfare and directed energy weapons."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "The Navy and Marines are concerned about swarms of cheap but lethal unmanned vehicles overwhelming defenses."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Firing expensive missiles to intercept a cheap drone puts Americans at a cost disadvantage."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Boxer fields RIM-7 Sea Sparrow missiles costing about $170,000 each and RIM-116 Rolling Airframe Missiles costing nearly a million dollars apiece."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "The Navy has tested less expensive options like 5-inch deck guns and the Phalanx Close-in Weapons System with limited success."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Callender said those options still cost thousands of dollars in rounds, while MADIS puts the cost exchange ratio in favor of the U.S."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "In 2014, the Navy deployed a 30-kilowatt laser aboard a ship that cost about a dollar per shot."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "The Navy plans to install a 60-kilowatt HELIOS directed energy weapon on a destroyer in 2021."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "The Navy is also developing the Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program (SEWIP) Block III for non-kinetic disabling of enemy missiles and UAVs."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "Callender said using systems like MADIS is less escalatory and provides deniability."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "In Bamyan province, children help with the potato harvest; many girls attend school for the first time, including 10-year-old Hamida who says she never went until last year."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Unicef reports that 3.2 million girls are now educated, a dramatic rise since the Taliban ban ended in 2001, but the female literacy rate has only tripled to 13% and women still face inequality and child marriages."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Gulnaz was raped, charged with adultery, gave birth in jail, and was later pardoned by President Karzai after international outcry; women's groups have criticized Karzai for not taking a stronger stand on women's rights."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "At Suriya school in Kabul, girls practice cricket with a male coach, supported by Afghan Connection and Marylebone Cricket Club; one 12-year-old girl says she wants to be a journalist."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Outside big cities, changes are patchy; 60% of the 4.2 million out-of-school children are girls, most in rural areas and conflict zones where conservative attitudes and Taliban activity limit education."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Teaching in southern Afghanistan is dangerous."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "There is anxiety that momentum for girls' education may not survive the US withdrawal in 2014, but Education Minister Farooq Wardak insists it will last."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "At a school opening in Bamyan, Wardak says only when women feel they own the nation can Afghanistan succeed."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Afghan Connection has funded over 30 schools, focusing on rural areas; director Dr. Sarah Fayne says the key is winning acceptance through proximity and female teachers."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Dr. Fayne says she believes the changes of the past decade are permanent."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Hamida works in the fields and helps at home but walks 2km to school six days a week."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Hamida's mother, who is 30 years old, says there was no school in her time, and Hamida wants to be a doctor."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Three people died in Southern California wildfires."},

    {"id": "2", "subevent": "The Saddleridge Fire ignited late Thursday in Sylmar, destroying over 30 structures and burning over 7,900 acres."},

    {"id": "4", "subevent": "At least 31 structures were damaged, with 13 destroyed, and over 1,000 firefighters responded."},

    {"id": "6", "subevent": "The National Weather Service warned of Red Flag conditions despite weaker winds."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "276 minors were evacuated from a juvenile detention center, and a hospital was placed under shelter-in-place."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "One civilian died from cardiac arrest and a firefighter sustained a minor injury."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "The cause of the fire is unknown; it was first reported at 9 p.m. Thursday."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "PG&E proactively shut off power to 800,000 customers in Northern and Central California."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "The Sandalwood Fire in Riverside County was 68% contained at 1,000 acres, with two deaths and 74 structures destroyed."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "Southern California Edison cut power to over 21,000 customers, later reduced to 54."},
    {"id": "13", "subevent": "SoCalGas reported no indications of damage or leaks at the Aliso Canyon facility."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "The Portuguese Episcopal Conference announced on Jan. 21 that public Masses would be suspended from Jan. 23 due to the extreme gravity of the coronavirus crisis."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The bishops stated that it is a moral imperative for all citizens to take maximum sanitary precautions to avoid contagion."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Portugal experienced a surge in COVID-19 deaths, with 609,000 cases and 9,920 deaths recorded as of Jan. 22."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "This was the second suspension of public worship by the bishops, the first being in March 2020 with restrictions eased at the end of May."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "The bishops said that public Masses, catechesis, and other pastoral activities requiring gatherings would be suspended, and they called on priests to offer livestreamed Masses."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Earlier in January, the bishops called for the suspension or postponement of baptisms, confirmations, and marriages."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "They said funerals could be celebrated according to norms issued in May 2020 requiring social distancing."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "A Lenten retreat for the bishops scheduled for Feb. 22-26 was canceled."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "The Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima announced it would broadcast three Masses and two rosary prayers daily via its website during the suspension."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Shrine rector Fr. Carlos Cabecinhas commented that following via television is not the same as being physically present but is the only possible way to participate now."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "A report found that a series of failures led to the crash of a Lion Air flight, killing 189 people and leading to the grounding of the Boeing 737 Max."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Investigators said faults by Boeing, Lion Air, and pilots caused the crash."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Five months after the Lion Air crash, an Ethiopian Airlines plane crashed, killing all 157 people on board, which led to the grounding of the entire 737 Max fleet."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "On Friday, Indonesian air crash investigators released their final report detailing the events that caused the Lion Air jet to plunge into the Java Sea."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "The report found that the jet should have been grounded before the fatal flight due to an earlier cockpit issue, but because the issue was not recorded properly, the plane was allowed to take off."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "The report found that a crucial sensor bought from a repair shop in Florida had not been properly tested, and the US aviation regulator revoked that company's certification."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "The sensor fed information to the MCAS system, which repeatedly pushed the plane's nose down, and investigators identified issues with the system, including incorrect assumptions about its behavior and deficiencies in training."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "The report found that the first officer, who had performed poorly in training, struggled to run through procedures and was flying the plane just before the fatal dive, and the captain had not briefed him properly when handing over controls."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "The report found that 31 pages were missing from the plane's maintenance log."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Indonesian authorities laid out recommendations for Boeing, including that it redesign MCAS and provide adequate information in pilot manuals and training."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Boeing said it was addressing the recommendations and taking actions to enhance the safety of the 737 Max."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Boeing ousted Kevin McAllister, chief executive of Boeing Commercial Airplanes."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "Boeing said it expected the 737 Max to be re-certified for flying by the end of the year."},
    {"id": "13", "subevent": "A Lion Air spokesman said the crash was an unthinkable tragedy and that corrective actions were essential."},
    {"id": "14", "subevent": "Revelations emerged that in 2016, Boeing employees exchanged messages about issues with MCAS while the plane was being certified."},
    {"id": "15", "subevent": "In documents provided to lawmakers, a pilot wrote that he had run into unexpected trouble during tests and had basically lied to regulators unknowingly."},
    {"id": "16", "subevent": "Boeing developed a training update and expected regulators to allow the planes to return to the skies before the beginning of 2020."},
    {"id": "17", "subevent": "Boeing's profits more than halved to $895m in the third quarter, and the firm said it would cut production of its 787 Dreamliner, blaming trade uncertainties."},
    {"id": "18", "subevent": "Boeing boss Dennis Muilenburg was stripped of his title as chairman by the board but remains as chief executive."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko said it was 'absolutely possible' his forces helped people cross into the European Union."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Lukashenko denied inviting migrants to Belarus, saying 'I didn’t invite them here.'"},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "European governments accused Belarus of artificially creating the crisis by bringing in people from abroad and taking them to the border."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Polish border guards reported attempted crossings from Belarus by two groups of migrants, one involving 500 people, some of whom threw rocks and tear gas canisters, aided by Belarusian authorities."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Polish border guards said they arrested 45 people."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Al Jazeera stated it was unable to independently verify claims about activity on the border as Poland has banned reporters from accessing the 3km-wide zone."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Poland's accusation suggested the crisis has not been resolved by an apparent change of tack by Minsk, which on Thursday cleared the main camps and allowed the first repatriation flight to Iraq in months."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Aid groups reported at least 11 asylum seekers and refugees have died on both sides of the border since the crisis began, with concerns for wellbeing amid freezing winter conditions."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Human rights groups said Poland has exacerbated suffering by sending back those who try to cross, while Poland said this is necessary to stop more from coming."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Poland and its allies accused Belarus of deliberately enticing thousands of migrants and refugees and funnelling them to the border in response to Western sanctions."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Minsk denied the accusations and accused Polish security forces of carrying out crimes against humanity while repelling people trying to enter the EU."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Lukashenko and Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke by phone and stressed the importance of cooperation between Minsk and the EU to resolve the problem."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "Ukraine said it was preparing 'systematically and thoroughly' in case the crisis shifted to its territory."},
    {"id": "13", "subevent": "Ukrainian Interior Minister Denys Monastyrsky warned that Russia might decide to send a large number of illegal migrants through Belarus to Ukraine."},
    {"id": "14", "subevent": "Monastyrsky said migrants who decide to cross into Ukraine will be pushed back with any means necessary, including firearms."},
    {"id": "15", "subevent": "Polish Defence Minister Mariusz Blaszczak tweeted that Warsaw was 'happy to accept Estonia’s proposal' to send 100 troops to the border."},
    {"id": "16", "subevent": "Migrants from the camps on the Belarusian side were taken to a huge, crowded warehouse and journalists were permitted to film them."},
    {"id": "17", "subevent": "23-year-old electrician Mohammed Noor told Reuters that the situation is temporary and he wishes to go to Europe and live a stable life."},
    {"id": "18", "subevent": "In a hospital in Bielsk Podlaski, Poland, two migrants who had been caught after crossing were given treatment before being taken away by Polish border guards."},
    {"id": "19", "subevent": "Mansour Nassar, 42, from Aleppo, described his ordeal in the forest, including being told by the Belarusian army: 'If you come back, we will kill you.'"},
    {"id": "20", "subevent": "Syrian refugee doctor Kassam Shahadah said patients were terrified of being forcibly returned to Belarus, calling what they lived through 'a nightmare for them.'"},
    {"id": "21", "subevent": "Council of Europe human rights commissioner Dunja Mijatovic called the humanitarian situation along the border 'alarming' and demanded an end to Poland’s controversial returns of migrants to Belarus."},
    {"id": "22", "subevent": "Mijatovic also called on Poland to allow rights activists and media 'immediate and unimpeded access to all areas along the border.'"},
    {"id": "23", "subevent": "Belarus said Thursday there were about 7,000 migrants in the ex-Soviet country."}
  ]
}

    {"id": "5", "subevent": "In Spain and Paris, Women’s Day events continued as scheduled."},

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "A historic LGBT+ rights conference was planned to be held in Ghana."},

    {"id": "10", "subevent": "A spokesperson for the Ghana ministry of gender, children and social protection said the government won't allow the conference, not because of coronavirus."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Last month, Ashanti regional chief Imam Sheihk Muumin Abdul Haroun vowed to stop the 'demonic' conference."},

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Pope Francis blessed two large 'Voice of the Unborn' bells headed to Ukraine and Ecuador."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The bells received the papal blessing before the general audience at the Vatican on October 27."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "The bells are part of an initiative by the Polish Yes to Life foundation, which had a bell blessed last year that traveled to nearly 30 cities in Poland."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Pope Francis said in a greeting that he blessed the bells and they are destined for Ecuador and Ukraine as a sign of commitment to defending human life."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "He expressed hope that their sound will announce the 'Gospel of life,' awaken consciences, and remind of the unborn."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "He entrusted every conceived child to prayer."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "One bell will be given to the St. John Paul II Shrine in Lviv, Ukraine, and the other to the Diocese of Guayaquil in Ecuador."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "The bells will travel to various events in those cities so people can ring them as an expression of pro-life beliefs."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "The bells were cast in the workshop of Jan Felczyński in Przemyśl, each weighing over 2,000 pounds and nearly four feet in diameter."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "The bells are decorated with a DNA chain, an ultrasound of an unborn child, an image of the stone tables with the Ten Commandments, and bear the words 'Thou shalt not kill' in Spanish and Ukrainian."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "The bells also include the words of Jeremiah 1:5 and a quote from Pope John Paul II's encyclical Evangelium vitae."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "King Salman of Saudi Arabia landed in Indonesia, becoming the first Saudi monarch to visit since 1970."},
